STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE: SOP-MNT-401
DOCUMENT CLASSIFICATION: CONFIDENTIAL
DEPARTMENT: MAINTENANCE / ROTATING EQUIPMENT
TITLE: HIGH PRESSURE FEED PUMP P-401 EMERGENCY BYPASS AND VALVE ISOLATION

1. PURPOSE & SCOPE
This document governs emergency and scheduled bypass operations on high pressure feed pump P-401 located in Processing Unit 4. Operating discharge pressures reach 145 bar (2,100 PSI). Strict safety protocols must be followed to avoid catastrophic overpressurization, line rupture, or hazardous fluid release.

2. PREREQUISITES & SAFETY EQUIPMENT
- Full personal protective equipment (PPE): chemical splash suit, face shield, and self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) on standby.
- Gas detector calibrated for hydrocarbon and H2S detection active within 15 meters.
- Authorised hot work and bypass permit signed by the Maintenance Approver.

3. EMERGENCY BYPASS EXECUTION SEQUENCE
Step 1: Verify redundant discharge sensor PT-401B is operational and reading baseline pressure.
Step 2: Notify the Central Control Room (CCR) before opening bypass valve MOV-401-BP.
Step 3: Gradually crack bypass valve MOV-401-BP by 15% to relieve line differential pressure. Monitor flow telemetry for cavitational vibration.
Step 4: Once bypass flow reaches 45 cubic meters/hour, manually depressurize the strainer casing using bleed valve BV-12.
Step 5: Engage the manual mechanical lock on isolation gate valve GV-401-IN. Do not attempt an emergency override of the interlock without supervisory authorization.

4. POST-BYPASS VERIFICATION & RE-ALIGNMENT
- Inspect seal flush fluid reservoir level and record differential pressure across orifice RO-401.
- Log final stabilization pressures in the maintenance dispatch log.
- Ensure automated shutdown trip alarms are restored to ACTIVE state within 30 minutes of maintenance completion.
